question: Should this stacked draft introduce mutating Claws workspace/persona file writes now, and must the workspace-ref table move into the canonical shared-state schema before merge?
rationale: This is a new user-facing mutating CLI mode plus persistent state tied to an open RFC/stack, so automation cannot decide product sequencing or permanent schema ownership alone.

options.title: Accept After Schema Repair
options.body: Keep the PR open, require the workspace-ref table and generated DB types to move under the canonical state schema, then review after the prerequisite stack is accepted.

options.title: Hold Behind Prerequisites
options.body: Pause this draft until the non-mutating Claws validation and artifact provenance PRs are accepted or reshaped.

options.title: Fold Into Installer Slice
options.body: Close or supersede this draft if maintainers want workspace writes, artifact installers, and remove semantics to land as one reviewed lifecycle slice.

recommendation.title: Accept After Schema Repair
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open, require the workspace-ref table and generated DB types to move under the canonical state schema, then review after the prerequisite stack is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice crosses shared-state schema ownership and CLI product sequencing, and current-main history points most strongly to this routing candidate.
